nom: MEDIHEAL Blackhead Melting Clear Nose Patch

segments.oily: One reviewer notes the product worked less impressively on her fiancé's oily skin than on her own, though it still removed visible debris from his pores.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report the two-step process pulls visible blackheads and debris out of the nose immediately, but a few say the strip did not stick to their skin or produced no visible change at all, and two reviewers with enlarged pores say it did not clear their deeper, stubborn blackheads or tighten their pores.
concerns.oiliness: Two reviewers explicitly distinguish sebum from blackheads, reporting the patch reliably draws out sebum filaments but does not clear their deeper blackheads.

aspects.libelle: First-step patch does not stick well to the curve of the nose
Included spatula tool works well for extraction
Results are described as dramatic and immediate by many users
Does not tighten enlarged pores despite that being expected

extraits.texte: I followed the directions perfectly and honestly this did absolutely nothing for me. Sad that I wasted money on this.

extraits.titre: Did not work for me at all
extraits.texte: I usually have good luck with pore strips, and wanted to try something new and possibly more effective, but this product missed the mark. First of all, the sheet would NOT stick to my face no matter what I did. There was no adhesive on it or anything, so it just kind of hung on my nose and I couldn't look down or it would fall off. I followed the instructions and left it on for 15 minutes and I saw absolutely not a single difference. Used the little spatula and everything; nothing happened at all. Waste of time and money.
The tool that it came with was nice but it's nothing special. Not worth the money. I have huge pores and it still only really helped with sebum

I must not have used this correctly????? I followed the directions to a 'T' but did not see any positive results and was very disappointed especially given all the positive reviews. I don't have issues with blackheads, just enlarged pores, so maybe that is my issue is that this product is more designed for blackheads BUT maybe should not be marketed for tightening pores???? Maybe it's just me.

After years on years of exfoliating, pore strips, and peels, I skeptically used this product to attemp to clear my blackheads. After using step 1, all of the blackheads in my nose rose to the top of my skin, to be easily removed with step 2, the spatula. I don't understand how this works, but I will be purchasing again!!

I bought this on a whim and I am glad I did! like another poster, I wish I had taken a before picture because it appears to be highly effective. At first glance after removing step 1, I had to do a double take. After step 2, and step 3 were complete, it looked like it removed all of the junk that was in my pore prior. I was so impressed that I used one next on my fiance's nose. He has very oily skin and so I wanted to see how effective it was. The results on my fiance weren't as impressive as mine. But this absolutely works. TL;DR this product is works.

I was a bit skeptical about whether these would be effective, but they are! I have a lot of enlarged pores and blackheads on my nose and these got rid of them in just 30 minutes. Definitely going to be repurchasing these!

reserve: Reviewers for this product rarely describe their own skin type; most reviews focus on the blackhead-removal result itself rather than a broader skin profile.
